punctuated:
《天順四年進士登科録》

玉音

天順四年二月二十六日，禮部尚書臣蕭晅等官於奉天門奏，為科舉事：會試天下舉人，取中一百五十六名，本年三月初一日殿試，合請讀卷及執事等官吏部尚書王翺等四十三員。其進士出身等第，恭依太祖高皇帝欽定資格：第一甲例取三名，第一名從六品，第二、第三名正七品，賜進士及第；第二甲從七品，賜進士出身；第三甲正八品，賜同進士出身。奉聖旨：「是。欽此。」

讀卷官
資善大夫、吏部尚書兼翰林院學士李賢〔癸丑進士〕
資德大夫、正治上卿、吏部尚書王翺〔乙未進士〕
户部尚書年富〔丁酉貢士〕
translation_en:
Record of the Metropolitan Graduates of the Fourth Year of the Tianshun Era (Tianshun sinian jinshi dengke lu)

Imperial Pronouncements

On the twenty-sixth day of the second month of the fourth year of the Tianshun era [March 18, 1460], your servant Xiao Xuan 蕭晅, Minister of Rites, and other officials memorialized at the Gate of Heaven's Mandate (Fengtian men) concerning the civil service examinations: In the Metropolitan Examination of provincial graduates (juren) from throughout the realm, one hundred and fifty-six men have been selected as passing candidates. For the Palace Examination on the first day of the third month of the present year [March 23, 1460], it is proper to request forty-three officials, including Wang Ao 王翺, Minister of Personnel, to serve as Readers of the Examination Papers and administrative functionaries. As for the grades and statuses of the metropolitan graduates (jinshi), they shall respectfully follow the qualifications imperially established by the Grand Progenitor, Emperor Gao [the Hongwu Emperor]: In the First Class, according to precedent, three men are selected; the first-ranked is accorded rank 6b, and the second- and third-ranked are accorded rank 7a, all being conferred the title "Metropolitan Graduate with Honors" (jinshi jidi). Those in the Second Class are accorded rank 7b and conferred the title "Metropolitan Graduate" (jinshi chushen). Those in the Third Class are accorded rank 8a and conferred the title "Associate Metropolitan Graduate" (tong jinshi chushen).

An Imperial Edict was received: "Approved. Respect this."

Readers of the Examination Papers

Li Xian 李賢, Grand Master for Assisting toward Goodness, Minister of Personnel, concurrently Hanlin Academician (metropolitan graduate of the guichou year [1433]).

Wang Ao 王翺, Grand Master for Assisting toward Virtue, Senior Worthy of Rectified Governance, and Minister of Personnel (metropolitan graduate of the yiwei year [1415]).

Nian Fu 年富, Minister of Revenue (tribute scholar [gongshi] of the dingyou year [1417]).

translation_en:
Sequence of Imperial Favors and Honors (Enrong cidi)

In the fourth year of the Tianshun reign (1460), early in the morning on the first day of the third month, the Tribute Scholars (gongshi) proceeded to the Inner Palace for the Palace Examination (dianshi). His Majesty took His seat in the Fengtian Hall (Fengtian dian) and personally bestowed the policy question.

Early in the morning on the third day of the third month, the civil and military officials stood in attendance in court dress, and the Embroidered-Uniform Guard (Jinyiwei) set out the Imperial Procession Guard (lubu) upon the Vermilion Steps and within the Vermilion Courtyard. His Majesty took His seat in the Fengtian Hall, and officials of the Court of State Ceremonial (Honglusi) transmitted the imperial decree and called out the names on the roll. Officials of the Ministry of Rites (Libu) carried the yellow placard, led by drums and music, out through the Left Chang'an Gate (Chang'an zuomen) to post it on display. When this was completed, officials of Shuntian Prefecture (Shuntian fu) escorted the Optimus (zhuangyuan) back to his residence with parasols and a ceremonial retinue.

translation_en:
On the fourth day of the third month, a banquet was bestowed at the Ministry of Rites (Libu 禮部). When the banquet concluded, they proceeded to the Court of State Ceremonial (Honglusi 鴻臚寺) to rehearse the court rituals.
On the fifth day of the third month, court dress, a cap, and a belt were bestowed upon the Principal Graduate (zhuangyuan 狀元), and paper currency (baochao 寶鈔) was bestowed upon the metropolitan graduates (jinshi 進士).
On the sixth day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led the metropolitan graduates in presenting a memorial to express gratitude for imperial grace.
On the seventh day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led the metropolitan graduates to the Temple of the Former Teacher Confucius to perform the ritual offering of vegetables (shicai 釋菜). Upon a memorialized request from the Ministry of Rites, the Ministry of Works (Gongbu 工部) was ordered to erect a stone stele inscribed with their names at the Directorate of Education (Guozijian 國子監).

朱賢〔貫直隸廬州府六安州軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字從善，行一，年三十三，八月三十日生〕。曾祖華；祖貴；父鑑；母邵氏。具慶下。弟良、方、正、愷、悌。娶許氏。應天府鄉試第一百三十三名，會試第七十八名。
translation_en:
Pan Li 潘禮 [registered as a military household in Guide Guard 歸德衛 in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); a National University Student (guozisheng 國子生) specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing 書經); courtesy name Jiahui 嘉會; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the fourth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Pan Fu 潘福, his grandfather was Pan Delin 潘得林, his father is Pan Zhong 潘忠, and his mother is née Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Pan Cong 潘聰, Pan Su 潘肅, and Pan Zhe 潘哲. He is married to née Lu 陸氏. He placed forty-fourth in the Henan 河南 Provincial Examination and sixty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Yi 楊繹 [registered as a civilian household in Taihe County 太和縣, Dali Prefecture 大理府, Yunnan 雲南; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing 詩經); courtesy name Zongsi 宗嗣; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the tenth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Huai 楊懷 [Supervisor (tiju 提舉) of Dali Route 大理路 under the Yuan dynasty], his grandfather was Yang Jiu 楊救, his father was Yang Ziyuan 楊子淵 [Instructor (jiaoyu 教諭) in the Pengxi County 蓬溪縣 Confucian School], and his mother is née Li 李氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Yang Jin 楊縉, Yang Shen 楊紳, Yang Die 楊絰, Yang Jing 楊經 [Assistant Instructor (xundao 訓導) in the Nanxi County 南溪縣 Confucian School], and Yang Wei 楊緯 [Secretary (zhushi 主事) in the Ministry of Revenue]; his younger brothers are Yang Gang 楊綱, Yang Ji 楊紀, and Yang Hui 楊繢. He is married to née Dong 董氏. He placed fifteenth in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and sixty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Kongzhao 黃孔昭 [registered as a civilian household in Huangyan County 黃巖縣, Taizhou Prefecture 台州府, Zhejiang 浙江; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shixian 世顯; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-third day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Huang Gushi 黃谷時, his grandfather was Huang Shangbin 黃尚斌, his father was Huang Yanjun 黃彥俊 [Secretary in the Ministry of War], and his mother was née Jin 金氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brother is Huang Kongying 黃孔英. He is married to née Cai 蔡氏. He placed seventy-sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Xian 朱賢 [registered as a military household in Lu'an Subprefecture 六安州, Luzhou Prefecture 廬州府, in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing 易經); courtesy name Congshan 從善; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the thirtieth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhu Hua 朱華, his grandfather was Zhu Gui 朱貴, his father is Zhu Jian 朱鑑, and his mother is née Shao 邵氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Zhu Liang 朱良, Zhu Fang 朱方, Zhu Zheng 朱正, Zhu Kai 朱愷, and Zhu Ti 朱悌. He is married to née Xu 許氏. He placed one hundred and thirty-third in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and seventy-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

楊瑛〔貫福建建寧府建安縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字希玉，行四，年二十九，正月十二日生〕。曾祖和；祖謙〔教諭〕；父暾〔縣丞〕；母陳氏。慈侍下。兄玹、珝，弟琯、珉。娶朱氏。福建鄉試第一名，會試第二十五名。

張元禎〔貫江西南昌府南昌縣軍籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字廷祥，行一，年二十三，三月初九日生〕。曾祖伯洪；祖孟初；父仲實；母倪氏。具慶下。弟元輔、元愷。聘程氏。江西鄉試第四十五名，會試第五名。

呂鳳〔貫浙江紹興府新昌縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《書經》，字好儀，行二十七，年三十四，六月初七日生〕。曾祖子華；祖必用〔本縣學訓導〕；父存酌；前母朱氏；母林氏。慈侍下。兄鴻、鵬、鷹、鶚。娶黃氏。浙江鄉試第三十七名，會試第九十六名。

陳選〔貫浙江台州府臨海縣軍籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字士賢，行二，年三十二，十一月二十八日生〕。曾祖濬圭；祖泰生〔贈監察御史〕；父員韜〔福建右布政使〕；母金氏〔贈孺人〕；繼母沈氏。永感下。兄英〔丙子貢士〕，弟箴、新、欽、錄。娶王氏。浙江鄉試第二十一名，會試第一名。
translation_en:
Yang Ying 楊瑛 [registered in a civilian household of Jian'an County 建安縣, Jianning Prefecture 建寧府, Fujian 福建; National University Student (guozi sheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Xiyu 希玉; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine; born on the twelfth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Yang He 楊和; his grandfather was Yang Qian 楊謙 [Instructor (jiaoyu)]; his father was Yang Tun 楊暾 [Assistant Magistrate (xiancheng)]; and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. His mother is living (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Yang Xuan 楊玹 and Yang Xu 楊珝, and his younger brothers are Yang Guan 楊琯 and Yang Min 楊珉. He married née Zhu 朱氏. He placed first in the Fujian Provincial Examination and twenty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Yuanzhen 張元禎 [registered in a military household of Nanchang County 南昌縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi 江西; County School Student (xianxue sheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingxiang 廷祥; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-three; born on the ninth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Bohong 張伯洪; his grandfather was Zhang Mengchu 張孟初; his father is Zhang Zhongshi 張仲實; and his mother is née Ni 倪氏. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia). His younger brothers are Zhang Yuanfu 張元輔 and Zhang Yuankai 張元愷. He is betrothed to née Cheng 程氏. He placed forty-fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lü Feng 呂鳳 [registered in a civilian household of Xinchang County 新昌縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang 浙江; Added County School Student (xianxue zengguang sheng); specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Haoyi 好儀; twenty-seventh in seniority among his cousins; aged thirty-four; born on the seventh day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Lü Zihua 呂子華; his grandfather was Lü Biyong 呂必用 [Assistant Instructor (xundao) in the Confucian School of this county]; his father was Lü Cunzhuo 呂存酌; his father's first wife was née Zhu 朱氏; and his mother is née Lin 林氏. His mother is living (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Lü Hong 呂鴻, Lü Peng 呂鵬, Lü Ying 呂鷹, and Lü E 呂鶚. He married née Huang 黃氏. He placed thirty-seventh in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and ninety-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Xuan 陳選 [registered in a military household of Linhai County 臨海縣, Taizhou Prefecture 台州府, Zhejiang 浙江; National University Student (guozi sheng); specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Shixian 士賢; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two; born on the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Jungui 陳濬圭; his grandfather was Chen Taisheng 陳泰生 [posthumously honored as Investigating Censor (jiancha yushi)]; his father was Chen Yuantao 陳員韜 [Right Administration Commissioner (you buzhengshi) of Fujian]; his mother was née Jin 金氏 [posthumously honored as Child Nurturer (ruren)]; and his stepmother was née Shen 沈氏. Both of his parents are deceased (yonggan xia). His elder brother is Chen Ying 陳英 [Tribute Student (gongshi) of the bingzi year (1456)], and his younger brothers are Chen Zhen 陳箴, Chen Xin 陳新, Chen Qin 陳欽, and Chen Lu 陳錄. He married née Wang 王氏. He placed twenty-first in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and first in the Metropolitan Examination.

黃景隆〔貫福建福州府長樂縣，民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字升叔，行三，年三十六，七月三十日生〕。曾祖進功；祖繼；父思警，母潘氏。嚴侍下。兄均〔任長史〕、坦、景昭；弟景輔。娶陳氏。福建鄉試第十三名，會試第二十三名。

沈暉〔貫直隸常州府宜興縣，民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字時暘，行二，年二十二，十一月二十六日生〕。曾祖原澤〔同知〕；祖榮；父彜，母崔氏。重慶下。兄曦；弟曄、昞、昕。聘屠氏。應天府鄉試第七十九名，會試第八十二名。

徐傅〔貫直隸蘇州府長洲縣，軍籍，府學生，治《易經》，字起巖，行四，年二十六，六月初二日生〕。曾祖本道；祖孟適；父裔，母丁氏，繼母盧氏。重慶下。兄倫、伸、保；弟俊、伊、伯、仲。娶費氏。應天府鄉試第七十名，會試第一百一十名。
translation_en:
Zhang Nai 張鼐 [registered in Jiangdu County, Yangzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), under civilian household status; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Yaochen, first in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-fourth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Ruji; his grandfather was Zhang Jingyuan; his father is Zhang Jun, and his mother is née Liu. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Zhang Zi and Zhang Ding. He is betrothed to née Ni. He placed seventeenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and eighty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Jinglong 黃景隆 [registered in Changle County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian, under civilian household status; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Shengshu, third in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the thirtieth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Huang Jingong; his grandfather was Huang Ji; his father is Huang Sijing, and his mother was née Pan. His father is living (his mother having passed away). His elder brothers are Huang Jun [serving as Chief Administrator (zhangshi)], Huang Tan, and Huang Jingzhao; his younger brother is Huang Jingfu. He is married to née Chen. He placed thirteenth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Hui 沈暉 [registered in Yixing County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), under civilian household status; a County Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Shiyang, second in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-two, born on the twenty-sixth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Shen Yuanze [Vice Prefect (tongzhi)]; his grandfather is Shen Rong; his father is Shen Yi, and his mother is née Cui. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Shen Xi; his younger brothers are Shen Ye, Shen Bing, and Shen Xin. He is betrothed to née Tu. He placed seventy-ninth in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and eighty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Fu 徐傅 [registered in Changzhou County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), under military household status; a Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Qiyan, fourth in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-six, born on the second day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Bendao; his grandfather is Xu Mengshi; his father is Xu Yi, his mother was née Ding, and his stepmother is née Lu. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Xu Lun, Xu Shen, and Xu Bao; his younger brothers are Xu Jun, Xu Yi, Xu Bo, and Xu Zhong. He is married to née Fei. He placed seventieth in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and one hundred and tenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 天順四年進士登科錄

translation_en:
Ling Hao 凌鎬 [registered in Xincheng County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, under official household status (guanji); a County Confucian Student (xianxuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Shujing 叔京; first in his generation; aged thirty-one, born on the sixteenth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Ling Xinda 信達; his grandfather was Ling Zisheng 子昇 [posthumously titled Vice Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Justice]; his father is Ling Jin 謹, and his mother is Lady Yuan 袁氏. Both of his parents are living (juqingxia); his younger brothers are Ling Yu 鈺, Ling Jian 鑑, Ling Zi 鎡, and Ling Luan 鑾; he is married to Lady Yuan 袁氏. He placed 47th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 26th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ruan Wenying 阮文英 (Nguyễn Văn Anh) [registered in Cishan County (Từ Sơn), Wuning Subprefecture (Vũ Ninh), Beijiang Prefecture (Bắc Giang), Jiaozhi (Annam), under civilian household status (minji); a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Hefu 和父; first in his generation; aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-second day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Ruan Li 立; his grandfather was Ruan Zongwei 宗維 [County Defender of Cishan County]; his father is Ruan Ziyou 子游 [Director of a Construction Office in the Ministry of Works], his father's first wife was Lady Huang 黃氏, his mother was Lady Fan 范氏, and his stepmother was Lady Li 黎氏. His father is living (yanshixia); he is married to Lady He 何氏. He placed 155th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 70th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Xun 周巽 [registered in Jishui County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, under civilian household status; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Jingyong 敬用; third in his generation; aged thirty-three, born on the first day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Zibin 子賓 [posthumously titled Vice Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of War]; his grandfather was Zhou Qifeng 岐鳳 [Vice Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of War]; his father was Zhou Gongmao 功懋, his mother was Lady Wang 王氏, and his stepmother is Lady Liu 劉氏. His mother/stepmother is living (cishixia); his elder brothers are Zhou Huan 渙 and Zhou Fu 復 [Assistant Instructor in the Confucian School of Sha County], and his younger brother is Zhou Yi 益; he is married to Lady Hu 胡氏. He placed 141st in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 33rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Feng 周鳳 [registered in Didao County, Lintao Prefecture, Shaanxi, under civilian household status; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Wenxiang 文祥; second in his generation; aged thirty-six, born on the fourteenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Quan 全; his grandfather was Zhou Li 禮; his father was Zhou Ying 英, and his mother is Lady Liang 梁氏. His mother is living (cishixia); his elder brother is Zhou Lin 麟; he is married to Lady Ma 馬氏. He placed 24th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 21st in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhu Zheng 諸正 [registered in an artisan household in Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a County Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Yangmeng; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the first day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Hezhong, his grandfather was Shengzong, his father is Hao, his mother was née Fang, and his stepmother is née Ye. With both grandparents and parents living, he has younger brothers Yong and Rang, and is married to a woman née Xu. He placed 25th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 133rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Xuan 吳宣 [registered in an artisan household in Dantu County, Zhenjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yanming; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the fourth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Ren'er, his grandfather was Xingqi, his father is Gui, and his mother is née Xu. With both parents living, he has elder brothers Xi and Quan, and is married to a woman née Zhang. He placed 141st in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 66th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Gong 劉恭 [registered in a civilian household in Laoting County, Luan Subprefecture, Yongping Prefecture, Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jingzhi; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the eighth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Yanyi, his grandfather was Zhi, his father is Gui, his mother was née Li, and his stepmother is née Li. With both parents living, he has younger brothers Xian, Jin, and Chen, and is married to a woman née Zhang. He placed 129th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 261st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Wen 李溫 [registered in a military household in Huo County, Tong Subprefecture, Shuntian Prefecture; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Jinghe; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-second day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Wan [a Brigade Commander (Wanhu) in the Yuan dynasty], his grandfather was Tai [posthumously granted the title of Commandant of Resplendent Trust (Zhaoxin xiaowei)], his father was Xing, and his mother was née Jiang. With both parents deceased, he has elder brothers Jun [a tribute scholar (gongshi) of the gengwu year (1450)] and Zhe, and is married to a woman née Zhou. He placed 193rd in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 93rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Jun 陳峻 (registered in an official household of the Embroidered-uniform Guard, originally from Dantu County in the Metropolitan Area; Military Student at the Shuntian Prefectural School, specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Xiumin, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty, born on the fifth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Wenbi 文璧, his grandfather was Chen Sixian 思賢, his father is Chen Suichu 遂初 (Platoon Commander of the Embroidered-uniform Guard), and his mother is née Zhao 趙氏. Both his parents are living; he has younger brothers Chong 崇, Xue 嶨, and Yan 巘, and is married to née Xu 許氏. He placed 70th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 54th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ji Qin 紀欽 (registered in a civilian household of Kaizhou Subprefecture, Daming Prefecture in the Metropolitan Area; Directorate Student, specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Jingzhi, first in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-five, born on the twenty-sixth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Ji Zhu 著 (Right Assistant Censor-in-chief), his grandfather was Ji Yanchang 彥常, his father was Ji Zhen 振 (Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel), and his mother is née Ni 倪氏. His mother is living; he has younger brothers Xi 錫 and Quan 銓, and is married to née Li 李氏. He placed 16th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 142nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Pan Zhen 潘稹 (registered in a military household of Lu'an Subprefecture, Luzhou Prefecture in the Metropolitan Area; Directorate Student, specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Jingzheng, second in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-three, born on the sixteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Pan Rensan 仁三, his grandfather was Pan Ke 恪, his father was Pan Yue 岳 (Investigating Censor), and his mother is née Xu 徐氏. His mother is living; he has elder brothers He 和 and Mu 穆, younger brothers Zhong 種 and Ji 稷, and is married to née Wang 王氏. He placed 99th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 126th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Huai 徐懷 (registered in a civilian household of Jiande County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; Directorate Student, specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Mingde, eighth in seniority among brothers, aged thirty, born on the twenty-second day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Xu Min 旻 (posthumously honored as Prefect), his grandfather was Xu Yu 玉, his father was Xu Zongzheng 宗政, and his mother was née Tong 童氏. Both his parents are deceased; he has an elder brother Liang 良 and a younger brother Xing 性, and is married to née Wang 王氏. He placed 62nd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 52nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Jian 徐鑑 (registered in a civilian household of Chun'an County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Keming; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the seventeenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Canzhong, his grandfather was Zongxian, his father was Shigong, and his mother is née Wang. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brother is Shuo, and his younger brothers are Yu, Luan, Guan (a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of the dingchou year [1457]), and Zhao. He married née Wang. He ranked 102nd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 90th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Xie 汪諧 (registered in a military household of Renhe County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Boxie; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the fourth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Seng'er, his grandfather was Zhongren, his father was Shiyuan, and his mother is née Chu. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His younger brothers are Chi and Gui. He married née Zhang. He ranked 31st in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 18th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Tong 林同 (registered in a civilian household of Longxi County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Added Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Jinqing; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Yingzhong, his grandfather was Zhongmo, his father was Jingxian, and his mother is née Zheng. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His younger brothers are Ji, Biao, Fan, and Ge. He married née Xu. He ranked 42nd in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 126th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Tinglun 張廷綸 (registered in a civilian household of Pingnan County, Xunzhou Prefecture, Guangxi; Added Student of the Wengyuan County School in Guangdong specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yunyan; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Xiushi, his grandfather was Hui (District Magistrate), his father was Hui (Instructor), and his mother is née Huang. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brother is Tingshen. He married née Guo, and took née Cui as his second wife. He ranked 4th in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 91st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Yu 江豫 (registered in a civilian household of Dangtu County, Taiping Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; Student of the Directorate of Education [Guozisheng], specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Mengzhen, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-seven sui, born on the third day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Qingzhi, his grandfather was Yongcheng, his father was Run, his mother was née Chen, and his stepmother is née Du. His stepmother is living. His younger brother is Sheng. He is married to née Tang. He placed eighth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zhen 王震 (registered in a military household of Gaoyou Subprefecture, Yangzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; Student of the Directorate of Education [Guozisheng], specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Wenyu, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-one sui, born on the seventeenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Fu, his grandfather is Sheng, his father is Li, and his mother is née Fang. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Ji and Ying. He is married to née Hu. He placed seventy-sixth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Jin 張謹 (registered in a civilian household of Feicheng County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; Student of the Directorate of Education [Guozisheng], specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Wenjin, third in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-six sui, born on the eighth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Zongyan, his grandfather was Yuandu (Assistant Instructor of the Shilou County Confucian School), his father is Lian (Assistant Instructor of the Xiangshan County Confucian School), and his mother is née Liu. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Qian (Tribute Student [gongshi] of the jiazi year [1444]) and Cheng. He is married to née Yang. He placed forty-sixth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred fiftieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Zhengfang 周正方 (registered in a civilian household of Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; Prefectural School Student [fuxuesheng], specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Keda, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-four sui, born on the third day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Jing (Vice Director of the Messenger Office), his grandfather is Yongxi, his father is Suyi, and his mother is née Liu. Both his parents and grandparents are living. He is married to née Wu. He placed seventy-second in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and forty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Zhong 沈鍾 [registered in an artisan household in Shangyuan District 上元縣, Yingtian Prefecture 應天府; National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zhonglü 仲律; fourth in seniority; aged twenty-five, born on the twenty-ninth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Shen Yicheng 沈以誠; his grandfather was Shen Mengxin 沈孟新; his father is Shen Yuanben 沈原本; his father's former wife was Madam Zhou 周氏, and his mother is Madam Shu 舒氏. Both parents are living (juqing xia). His elder brothers are Shen Jian 沈鑑, Shen Duo 沈鐸, and Shen Yong 沈鏞, and his younger brother is Shen Kai 沈鎧. He married Madam Zhao 趙氏. He placed sixteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Fan 王璠 [registered in a military household in Xiuwu District 修武縣, Huaiqing Prefecture 懷慶府, Henan; Additional Student (zengguang sheng) at the District School; specialized in the Book of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Wenyu 文璵; first in seniority; aged thirty-eight, born on the eighteenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Detong 王德通; his grandfather was Wang Duo 王鐸 [Prefect (zhifu) of Jinhua Prefecture 金華府]; his father was Wang Mao 王懋 [Prefect of Xi'an Prefecture 西安府]; his mother was Madam Xu 徐氏, and his stepmother was Madam Zhang 張氏. Both parents are deceased (yonggan xia). His younger brother is Wang Min 王珉. He married Madam Li 李氏. He placed second in the Henan Provincial Examination and eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Yi 王誼 [registered in a civilian household in Jiangyin District 江陰縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student; specialized in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Kezheng 克正; first in seniority; aged thirty-six, born on the fourteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Cai 王釆; his grandfather was Wang Hong 王弘; his father is Wang Da 王達; and his mother is Madam Huang 黃氏. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Wang Mo 王謨. He married Madam Kong 孔氏. He placed seventy-seventh in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and thirty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Jian 劉健 [registered in a civilian household in Luoyang District 洛陽縣, Henan Prefecture 河南府, Henan; National University Student; specialized in the Book of Changes; courtesy name Xixian 希賢; second in seniority; aged twenty-eight, born on the eighth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Shaozu 劉紹祖 [Route Commander (zongguan) in the Yuan dynasty]; his grandfather was Liu Rong 劉榮; his father is Liu Liang 劉亮 [Instructor (jiaoyu) in the Sanyuan District School 三原縣學]; his father's principal wife is Madam Zhang 張氏, and his birth mother is Madam Bai 白氏. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Liu Kan 劉侃, and his younger brothers are Liu Ji 劉佶 and Liu Wei 劉偉. He married Madam Wang 王氏. Si Fu 司福 (registered under a military household in Zezhou 澤州, Shanxi 山西; a Student of the Directorate of Education [Guozisheng 國子生] specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing 書經]; courtesy name Xiqian 希謙; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-seventh day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Si Liqing 禮卿; his grandfather was Si Chengfu 誠甫 (posthumously honoured as Director of the Judicial Office of a Princely Establishment [Shenlizheng 審理正]); his father is Si Xian 憲 (Director of the Judicial Office of a Princely Establishment); and his mother was née Qin 秦氏 (invested as Mistress of Peace [Anren 安人]). His father is living. His elder brothers are Si Qi 齊 (Assistant Instructor [Xundao 訓導]) and Si Shou 壽, and his younger brother is Si Lu 祿. He married née Guan 官氏. He placed thirty-fourth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tu Guan 涂觀 (registered under an artisan household in Fengcheng County 豐城縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi 江西; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing 易經]; courtesy name Hengfu 恒孚; tenth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the fifteenth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Tu Wende 文德; his grandfather was Tu Guosheng 國昇; his father is Tu Yongzai 永載 (invested as Investigating Censor [Jiancha yushi 監察御史]); and his mother is née Gao 高氏 (invested as Child Nurturess [Ruren 孺人]). Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Tu Ren 仁, Tu Zhong 忠, Tu Lun 倫, Tu Qian 謙 (Surveillance Commissioner [Anchashi 按察使] of Guizhou 貴州), and Tu Xun 巽, and his younger brother is Tu Jin 晉. He married née Xu 徐氏. He placed fifty-fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and thirty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ren Xi 任璽 (registered under a military household in Taiping County 太平縣, Pingyang Prefecture 平陽府, Shanxi; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Tingxin 廷信; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the eleventh day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Ren Yanqing 彥卿; his grandfather was Ren Yuanli 原禮; his father was Ren Wenguang 文廣; his legal mother was née Zhang 張氏; and his birth mother is née Fan 范氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Ren Yu 玉, Ren Qi 玘, Ren Li 禮, Ren Hai 海, and Ren Zhen 珎. He placed eighty-eighth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Sheng 張盛 (registered under a civilian household in Yixing County 宜興縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸]; a County Student [Xianxuesheng 縣學生] specializing in the Classic of History; courtesy name Keqian 克謙; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the thirtieth day of the twelfth month). Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Zhang Li 禮, and his younger brothers are Zhang Yi 益 and Zhang Ang 盎. He married née Guo 郭氏, and subsequently married née Wang 王氏. He placed ninety-eighth in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and fifty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

His elder brothers are Zongyi, Zongshan, and Zongmei, and his younger brother is Zongxi. He married née Gong. He placed ninety-seventh in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and one hundred and third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiang Cheng 項澄: Registered in a saltern household in Fuqing County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; an Added Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Binghong; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the first day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Xiang Jun; his grandfather was Xiang Fu; his father is Xiang Zhen; and his mother is née Chen. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Tan and Yuan. He married née Chen. He placed eighty-fifth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Kai 蕭凱: Registered in the Wuding Independent Battalion of the Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yuzuo; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the fourteenth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Xiao Yousi; his grandfather was Xiao Fuquan; his father was Xiao Ming; and his mother is née Chen. His mother is living. His elder brother is Jing, and his younger brother is Fan. He married née Zeng. He placed sixty-eighth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and fifty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fang Bi 方泌 [registered in a civilian household of Kaihua County, Quzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Jiyuan; thirty-second in seniority among his generation; aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth lunar month]. His great-grandfather was Boxiang, his grandfather was Jifang, his father was Ying [Chief Messenger in the Messenger Office], and his mother is née Dai. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His younger brother is Hui. He married a woman née Xu. He ranked 13th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 85th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Ji 鄭紀 [registered in a military household of Xianyou County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Tinggang; fourth in seniority among his generation; aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-sixth day of the intercalary eighth lunar month]. His great-grandfather was Shuxiu, his grandfather was Lang, his father is Hengshu, and his mother is née Wu. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Ji, Lun, and Gang, and his younger brother is Ji. He married a woman née Huang. He ranked 19th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 12th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fan Mei 范鎂 [registered in a civilian household of Fengcheng County 豐城縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi; Added Student of the County School; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yanjun 彥俊; seventh in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the second day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Kongjing 孔京; his grandfather was Gui 貴 [Assistant Magistrate [?] (zhuji [?]), granted the prestige title of District Magistrate]; his father is Zhong 衷 [Department Magistrate of Ruzhou 汝州]; and his mother is née Zeng 曾 [granted the title of Child Nurturess]. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Jian 鑑, Yi 鎰, Yong 鏞 [Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice], Zhen 鎮, and Ding 錠; his younger brothers are Rui 銳, Ming 銘, Chun 錞, Qin 欽, and Tong 銅. He is married to a woman née Xiong 熊. He placed ninety-third in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Pan Xuan 潘瑄 [registered in a military household of Luoyang County 洛陽縣, Henan Prefecture 河南府, Henan; Student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Tingxi 廷璽; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the thirteenth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Yangang 彥剛; his grandfather is Shouxin 守信; his father is Qi 祺; and his mother is née Wang 王. Both his parents and grandparents are living. He is married to a woman née Hou 侯. He placed sixty-first in the Henan Provincial Examination and forty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Shan 趙繕 [registered in a civilian household of Linqing County 臨清縣, Dongchang Prefecture 東昌府, Shandong; Student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Xicheng 希成; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the eighth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Xin 信; his grandfather was Huan 桓 [ Assistant Magistrate of Wuqing County 武清縣]; his father is Jian 鑑 [Jail Warden of Weiyuan County 渭源縣]; and his mother is née Li 李. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Gang 綱, Ji 紀, Shen 紳, Shou 綬, and Chun 純. He is married to a woman née Cao 曹. He placed eighty-eighth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and ninety-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Zan 徐瓚 [registered in a civilian household of Yuyao County 餘姚縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang; Student of the County School; specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Tianxi 天錫; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the tenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Runqing 閏輕; his grandfather was Boyong 伯庸 [District Magistrate of Dingyuan County 定遠縣]; his father was Huai 淮; and his mother is née Chen 陳. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His younger brothers are Yao 瑤, Zhen 珎, and Zhang 璋. He is married to a woman née Huang 黃. He placed twentieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Ziyan 張子言 (registered under a military household in Shishou County, Jingzhou Prefecture, Huguang; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Yunjia; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight Sui, born on the twenty-sixth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Xingbo; his grandfather was Zhang Xiyuan; his father was Zhang Shun, his father's first wife was née Cheng, and his mother was née Wang. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Zhang Ziqi, and his younger brothers are Zhang Zijing and Zhang Zili. He married a woman née Lü. He placed second in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred and seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Hui 陳輝 (registered under a civilian household in Lingbi County, Suzhou Subprefecture, Fengyang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; an added student of the county school specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); style name Wenyao; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six Sui, born on the fifteenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Shida; his grandfather was Chen Yongji; his father is Chen Ru, his principal mother is née Ding, and his birth mother is née Jin. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Chen Zhao and Chen Liang. He married a woman née Zhao. He placed eleventh in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and fifty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chang Xian 常顯 (registered under a civilian household in Yushe County, Liaozhou Subprefecture, Shanxi; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Daoming; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight Sui, born on the fourth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Chang Yi; his grandfather was Chang Decai; his father is Chang Heng, and his mother is née Zhou. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Chang Fuhai and Chang Zishan. He married a woman née Zhou. He placed ninth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and thirty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Shu 閻恕 (registered under a civilian household in Xingyang County, Zhengzhou Subprefecture, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; a county school student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Xingren; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two Sui, born on the thirtieth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Yan Gui; his grandfather was Yan Sheng; his father is Yan Yi, his mother was née Zhang, and his stepmother was née Hou. His father is living, while his mother is deceased. His elder brother is Yan Zhong, and his younger brothers are Yan Mao, Yan Hui, and Yan Xian. He married a woman née Feng. He placed thirty-seventh in the Henan Provincial Examination and twenty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
王濬〔貫河南開封府陳州商水縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字文深，行一，年二十九，五月初五日生〕。曾祖彥和〔長安縣知縣〕；祖鳳儀〔巡檢〕；父亨，母張氏。具慶下。娶任氏。河南鄉試第五十四名，會試第一百十二名。
郝冕〔貫河南汝寧府光州民籍，州學增廣生，治《禮記》，字世瞻，行一，年二十四，九月初三日生〕。曾祖興〔元樞密院校書郎，贈兵部右侍郎〕；祖仲賢〔贈兵部右侍郎〕；父璜〔兵部右侍郎〕，母李氏〔封淑人〕。具慶下。娶張氏。河南鄉試第五十二名，會試第七十四名。
周宗智〔貫湖廣武昌府興國州大冶縣軍籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字子正，行四，年三十三，三月二十三日生〕。曾祖祖陸；祖添祐；父濟〔縣丞〕，母程氏。慈侍下。兄宗仁〔醫學訓術〕、宗義、宗禮，弟宗信、宗德。娶聶氏。湖廣鄉試第七十五名，會試第一百三十九名。
謝潤〔貫直隸徽州府祁門縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字德澤，行三，年三十五，十月初八日生〕。曾祖尹護；祖能靜；父文達，母胡氏，繼母方氏。具慶下。兄玉清、玉溫，弟玉淵。娶吳氏。應天府鄉試第一百八十六名，會試第八十名。
translation_en:
Wang Jun 王濬: Registered in a civilian household in Shangshui County, Chenzhou, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Wenshen; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the fifth day of the fifth month. His great-grandfather was Yanhe (District Magistrate of Chang'an County), his grandfather was Fengyi (Police Chief), his father is Heng, and his mother is née Zhang. Both of his parents are living. He is married to a woman née Ren. He ranked fifty-fourth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred and twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hao Mian 郝冕: Registered in a civilian household in Guangzhou, Runing Prefecture, Henan; Added Student of the subprefectural school; specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Shizhan; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the third day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Xing (Editing Clerk in the Bureau of Military Affairs under the Yuan, posthumously honored as Right Vice Minister of War), his grandfather was Zhongxian (posthumously honored as Right Vice Minister of War), his father is Huang (Right Vice Minister of War), and his mother is née Li (invested as Lady of Virtue). Both of his parents are living. He is married to a woman née Zhang. He ranked fifty-second in the Henan Provincial Examination and seventy-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Zongzhi 周宗智: Registered in a military household in Daye County, Xingguo Subprefecture, Wuchang Prefecture, Huguang; National University Student; specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Zizheng; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-third day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Zulu, his grandfather was Tianyou, his father was Ji (Assistant County Magistrate), and his mother is née Cheng. His mother is living (his father having passed away). His elder brothers are Zongren (Assistant Instructor of the Medical School), Zongyi, and Zongli; his younger brothers are Zongxin and Zongde. He is married to a woman née Nie. He ranked seventy-fifth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred and thirty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xie Run 謝潤: Registered in a civilian household in Qimen County, Huizhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student; specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Deze; third in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the eighth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Yinhu, his grandfather was Nengjing, his father is Wenda, his mother was née Hu, and his stepmother is née Fang. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brothers are Yuqing and Yuwen; his younger brother is Yuyuan. He is married to a woman née Wu. He ranked one hundred and eighty-sixth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and eightieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

王應奎〔貫浙江寧波府慈谿縣，軍籍。國子生，治《詩經》。字文徵，行五，年三十三，十二月十五日生〕。曾祖世達；祖思明〔贈工部郎中〕；父琴；母徐氏。具慶下。兄新；弟鑑、鍾、命、永。娶應氏。浙江鄉試第三十名，會試第一百名。

周銓〔貫雲南曲靖衛，軍籍，直隸興化縣人。國子生，治《詩經》。字秉衡，行四，年三十二，正月十四日生〕。曾祖仲良；祖海；父昂；母楊氏。慈侍下。兄顥〔嘉魚縣學教諭〕、鑑、鐸。聘米氏。雲南鄉試第七名，會試第四十名。
涂棐〔貫江西南昌府豐城縣，軍籍。國子生，治《書經》。字伯輔，行六，年三十五，五月初九日生〕。曾祖觀復；祖以良；父子雄；嫡母孟氏；母秦氏。永感下。兄伯行、伯寛、伯和、伯順、伯方。娶吳氏。江西鄉試第十八名，會試第五十名。
translation_en:
Wang Yingkui 王應奎 [registered in a military household of Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Wenzheng, fifth in seniority, aged thirty-three, born on the fifteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Shida; his grandfather was Wang Siming [posthumously honored as Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Works]; his father is Wang Qin; his mother is née Xu. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Wang Xin; his younger brothers are Wang Jian, Wang Zhong, Wang Ming, and Wang Yong. He married née Ying. He placed thirtieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundredth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Deng Benduan 鄧本端 [registered in a civilian household of Zi County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Chongzheng, first in seniority, aged thirty-seven, born on the sixteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Deng Ande [Instructor]; his grandfather was Deng Tingju; his father was Deng Cheng [Advisor in the Princely Establishment of Xiang]; his mother is née Chen. His mother is living. He married née Wang, and subsequently married née Fu. He placed thirtieth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred sixteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Quan 周銓 [registered in a military household of Qujing Guard, Yunnan, a native of Xinghua County in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Bingheng, fourth in seniority, aged thirty-two, born on the fourteenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Zhongliang; his grandfather was Zhou Hai; his father was Zhou Ang; his mother is née Yang. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Zhou Hao [Instructor of the Jiayu County Confucian School], Zhou Jian, and Zhou Duo. He is betrothed to née Mi. He placed seventh in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and fortieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tu Fei 涂棐 [registered in a military household of Fengcheng County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Bofu, sixth in seniority, aged thirty-five, born on the ninth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Tu Guanfu; his grandfather was Tu Yiliang; his father was Tu Zixiong; his legal mother was née Meng; his birth mother was née Qin. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Tu Bohang, Tu Bokuan, Tu Bohe, Tu Boshun, and Tu Bofang. He married née Wu. He placed eighteenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and fiftieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

侯英〔貫直隸大名府開州匠籍，國子生，治《書經》，字世傑，行二，年三十一，十二月初七日生〕。曾祖貴；祖隆〔贈監察御史〕；父春〔浙江按察司副使〕；母鍾氏〔贈孺人〕。慈侍下。兄佐，弟佑、傅、侃。娶謝氏。順天府鄉試第十五名，會試第三十名。

婁芳〔貫浙江紹興府會稽縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字永譽，行六，年三十三，十一月初一日生〕。曾祖善；祖敏名；父信；母林氏。慈侍下。兄永慶、永喜、永哲、永榮、永聯，弟永富、永能、永壽。娶傅氏。浙江鄉試第四十名，會試第三名。

孫佐〔貫太醫院籍，浙江仁和縣人，國子生，治《書經》，字時相，行一，年三十，六月二十八日生〕。曾祖茂和；祖孟仁；父愚〔御醫〕；母陳氏。具慶下。娶沈氏。順天府鄉試第二百四十六名，會試第一百四十四名。
translation_en:
Ye Sheng 葉盛, registered in a commoner household of Yugan County, Raozhou Prefecture, Jiangxi, was a National University Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji), with the courtesy name Jingyang, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the eighteenth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Ye Zhengrong; his grandfather was Ye Junhui, who served as a Unclassified Clerk (Dianshi); his father was Ye Cheng; and his mother was née Lü. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Ye Fuyang, Ye Kunyang, and Ye Yuanyang, and he is married to née Qi. He placed eighteenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and eighty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hou Ying 侯英, registered in an artisan household of Kaizhou, Daming Prefecture, in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili), was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing), with the courtesy name Shijie, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the seventh day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Hou Gui; his grandfather was Hou Long, posthumously granted the title of Investigating Censor; his father was Hou Chun, a Surveillance Vice Commissioner of Zhejiang; and his mother was née Zhong, posthumously granted the title of Child Nurturer (Ruren). His mother is living (or his stepmother/birth mother is living while his father is deceased). His elder brother is Hou Zuo, his younger brothers are Hou You, Hou Fu, and Hou Kan, and he is married to née Xie. He placed fifteenth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and thirtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lou Fang 婁芳, registered in a commoner household of Guiji County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, was a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu), with the courtesy name Yongyu, sixth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the first day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Lou Shan; his grandfather was Lou Minming; his father was Lou Xin; and his mother was née Lin. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Lou Yongqing, Lou Yongxi, Lou Yongzhe, Lou Yongrong, and Lou Yonglian, his younger brothers are Lou Yongfu, Lou Yongneng, and Lou Yongshou, and he is married to née Fu. He placed fortieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Zuo 孫佐, registered in a household of the Directorate of Imperial Medicine and a native of Renhe County, Zhejiang, was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing), with the courtesy name Shixiang, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the twenty-eighth day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Sun Maohe; his grandfather was Sun Mengren; his father was Sun Yu, an Imperial Physician; and his mother was née Chen. Both his parents are living, and he is married to née Shen. He placed two hundred forty-sixth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Li Tingmei 李廷美 (registered under civilian household status in Min County 閩縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian 福建; an added student of the county school specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Tingmei 廷美, third in seniority; aged twenty-four, born on the twenty-fifth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Li Tianyi 李天乙, his grandfather was Li Yue 李岳, his father is Li Sheng 李陞, and his mother is née Deng 鄧氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Li Tingshao 李廷韶 (Tribute Student [gongshi] of the jimao year [1459]), and his younger brothers are Li Ao 李鏖, Li Dian 李㶠, and Li Jian 李䥝. He married née Zeng 曾氏. He placed twenty-eighth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and ninety-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Xiong 沈熊 (registered under civilian household status in Gui'an County 歸安縣, Huzhou Prefecture 湖州府, Zhejiang 浙江; a student of the county school specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Wenrui 文瑞, second in seniority; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-fifth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Shen Zihua 沈子華, his grandfather was Shen Maolin 沈茂林, his father is Shen Degang 沈德剛, and his mother is née Ma 馬氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Shen Wenzhen 沈文禎, and his younger brothers are Shen Wenzuo 沈文祚, Shen Wensu 沈文肅, Shen Wenjun 沈文俊, and Shen Wenguang 沈文廣. He married née Xu 徐氏. He placed thirty-second in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Song Ying 宋𤩽 (registered under military household status in Laiyang County 萊陽縣, Dengzhou Prefecture 登州府, Shandong 山東; a student of the Directorate of Education [Guozisheng] specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Jingzhang 景章, second in seniority; aged forty-one, born on the sixteenth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Song Juren 宋居仁, his grandfather was Song Fuquan 宋福全, his father is Song Ji 宋積, and his mother is née Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Song Rong 宋榮, and his younger brothers are Song You 宋佑, Song Kuan 宋寬, Song Hong 宋宏, and Song De 宋德. He married née Zhao 趙氏. He placed seventy-seventh in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred and forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shao Cong 邵琮 (registered under civilian household status in Renhe County 仁和縣, Hangzhou Prefecture 杭州府, Zhejiang 浙江; an added student of the county school specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Shuzhang 叔璋, fourth in seniority; aged twenty-eight, born on the first day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Shao Shangde 邵尚德, his grandfather was Shao Guihe 邵貴和, his father was Shao Weizheng 邵惟政, and his mother was née Ma 馬氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Shao Xuan 邵瑄, Shao Heng 邵珩, and Shao Qi 邵玘. He married née Shi 施氏. He placed eighty-sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and thirtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Liu Qi 劉騏 (courtesy name Deliang 德良, fifth in seniority) was registered in a Confucian household in Fuliang County 浮梁縣, Raozhou Prefecture 饒州府, Jiangxi 江西. A National University Student (國子生) specializing in the Book of Documents (Shujing 書經), he was forty-seven sui, born on the twenty-third day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Liu Hanzong 漢宗, his grandfather was Liu Bochang 伯常, his father was Liu Ziliang 子諒, and his mother was née Tang 湯氏. Both parents were living. He had elder brothers Feng 鳳 and Qi 麒 [?], and younger brothers Jiu 鷲, Hong 鴻, and E 鶚. He married née Zheng 鄭氏, and after her death married née Hu 胡氏. He placed twenty-first in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and twenty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Bin 劉賓 (courtesy name Tingchen 廷臣, second in seniority) was registered in a civilian household in Wei County 魏縣, Daming Prefecture 大名府, Zhili 直隸. A National University Student specializing in the Book of Documents, he was thirty-six sui, born on the twenty-second day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Liu Qiyuan 啓淵, his grandfather was Liu Min 敏, his father was Liu Zhongli 仲禮, and his mother was née Bao 包氏. His mother was living. He had an elder brother Xuan 愃 and younger brothers Huan 寰 and Yu 宇. He married née Shi 石氏, and after her death married née Zhang 張氏. He placed two hundred and nineteenth in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred and thirty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Xu 張珝 (courtesy name Tingshen 廷紳, second in seniority) was registered in an artisan household in Gui'an County 歸安縣, Huzhou Prefecture 湖州府, Zhejiang 浙江. A National University Student specializing in the Book of Documents, he was thirty-eight sui, born on the twenty-second day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Zhang Guozhen 國珎, his grandfather was Zhang Zhongxian 仲賢, his father was Zhang Wenyi 文義, and his mother was née Wu 吳氏. His mother was living. He married née Chen 陳氏. He placed twenty-fifth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and eighty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Ying 楊瑩 (courtesy name Dajie 大潔, third in seniority) was registered in a military household in Puzhou 蒲州, Pingyang Prefecture 平陽府, Shanxi 山西. An Added Student (增廣生) of the Subprefectural School specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu 春秋), he was twenty-three sui, born on the sixteenth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Yang Zicong 子從, his grandfather was Yang Jingsheng 景昇, his father was Yang Zongyi 宗毅, and his mother was née Wei 衛氏. Both parents were living. He had elder brothers Xi 璽 and Guan 瓘, and married née Du 杜氏. He placed thirtieth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and thirtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

張同〔貫江西吉安府永新縣儒籍，國子生，治《易經》，字祖年，行一，年三十三，十一月二十九日生〕。曾祖節用；祖浩然；父洪翼，母龍氏，繼母劉氏。具慶下。弟周、因、固、圍、囿。娶顏氏，繼娶顏氏。江西鄉試第三十三名，會試第三十二名。
translation_en:
Ai Fu 艾福 (registered under a military household in the Xiangyang Escort Guard 襄陽護衛, Huguang; a student of the Directorate of Education [Guozisheng], specializing in the Book of Odes [Shijing]; style name Tianxi 天錫, first in seniority among brothers, aged forty-two, born on the twenty-fifth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Jimin 濟民 (Chief Judge of a Branch Secretariat [Sheng du zhenfu] in the Yuan dynasty); his grandfather was Wensheng 文盛; his father was Xian 賢, his mother was née Tang 湯, and his stepmother was née Wang 王. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are You 祐, Xiang 祥, Qi 祺, and Gui 禬. He married née Li 李, and remarried née Shi 石. He placed seventy-seventh in the Huguang Provincial Examination and eighty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Fan 王範 (registered under a commoner household in Kaizhou 開州, Daming Prefecture 大名府, Zhili; a student of the Directorate of Education, specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; style name Ziyi 子儀, second in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-fifth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Yu 玉; his grandfather was Furong 福榮 (Granary Assistant Commissioner [Cang fushi]); his father was Xin 信, his mother was née Zhang 張, and his stepmother was née Zhang 張. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Cong 聰, and his younger brothers are Zhong 忠, Hui 慧, Pu 普, Mao 懋, and De 悳. He married née Zhang 張. He placed eighty-ninth in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Xun 王塤 (registered under a commoner household in Xuzhou 許州, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan; a student of the Directorate of Education, specializing in the Book of Odes [Shijing]; style name Zongqi 宗器, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the third day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Zhong 忠; his grandfather was Xin 信; his father was Rong 榮, his mother was née Du 杜, and his stepmother was née Du 杜. Both his parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Yu 域, Cheng 城, Jing 境, and Tang 塘. He married née Chen 陳. He placed thirteenth in the Henan Provincial Examination and eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Tong 張同 (registered under a Confucian scholar household in Yongxin County 永新縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi; a student of the Directorate of Education, specializing in the Book of Changes [Yijing]; style name Zunian 祖年, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-ninth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Jieyong 節用; his grandfather was Haoran 浩然; his father was Hongyi 洪翼, his mother was née Long 龍, and his stepmother was née Liu 劉. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Zhou 周, Yin 因, Gu 固, Wei 圍, and You 囿. He married née Yan 顏, and remarried née Yan 顏. He placed thirty-third in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and thirty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

辜顓〔貫江西饒州府安仁縣軍籍，縣學生，治《禮記》，字主敬，行三，年三十六，正月初五日生〕。曾祖以辰，祖彥芳，父嗣宗，母鄭氏。具慶下。兄顗、顥，弟穎。娶蘇氏。江西鄉試第十三名，會試第六十五名。
丘霽〔貫遼東定遼右衛軍籍，江西鄱陽縣人，國子生，治《詩經》，字時雍，行一，年三十二，二月初十日生〕。曾祖伯英，祖思文，父孔暉，母張氏。具慶下。弟霖。娶周氏，繼娶鍾氏，聘胡氏。山東鄉試第十八名，會試第四十八名。
陳煒〔貫福建福州府閩縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《春秋》，字文曜，行一，年三十一，八月十七日生〕。曾祖鈺，祖周〔封監察御史〕，父叔剛〔翰林院侍讀〕，母林氏〔封孺人〕，生母林氏。慈侍下。弟燿。娶林氏。福建鄉試第二十四名，會試第五十一名。
饒欽〔貫直隸徽州府祁門縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字克恭，行四，年四十五，十一月二十二日生〕。曾祖春壽，祖均亮，父友善，母余氏。慈侍下。兄顯、敬、晃，弟宗。娶陳氏。應天府鄉試第一百名，會試第五十八名。
translation_en:
Gu Zhuan 辜顓 [registered in a military household of Anren County 安仁縣, Raozhou Prefecture 饒州府, Jiangxi 江西; County School Student, specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Zhujing 主敬, third in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the fifth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Gu Yichen 以辰, his grandfather was Gu Yanfang 彥芳, his father is Gu Sizong 嗣宗, and his mother is née Zheng 鄭氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Gu Yi 顗 and Gu Hao 顥, and his younger brother is Gu Ying 穎. He married a woman née Su 蘇氏. He placed thirteenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and sixty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qiu Ji 丘霽 [registered in a military household of Dingliao Right Guard 定遼右衛 in Liaodong 遼東, originally from Poyang County 鄱陽縣, Jiangxi 江西; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shiyong 時雍, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the tenth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Qiu Boying 伯英, his grandfather was Qiu Siwen 思文, his father is Qiu Konghui 孔暉, and his mother is née Zhang 張氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Qiu Lin 霖. He married a woman née Zhou 周氏, took as his second wife a woman née Zhong 鍾氏, and is betrothed to a woman née Hu 胡氏. He placed eighteenth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and forty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Wei 陳煒 [registered in a civilian household of Min County 閩縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian 福建; Added-quota County School Student, specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Wenyao 文曜, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the seventeenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Yu 鈺, his grandfather was Chen Zhou 周 [invested with the title of Investigating Censor], his father was Chen Shugang 叔剛 [Hanlin Expositor-in-waiting], his principal mother is née Lin 林氏 [invested as Child-Nurturess], and his birth mother is née Lin 林氏. His mother is living. His younger brother is Chen Yao 燿. He married a woman née Lin 林氏. He placed twenty-fourth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and fifty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Rao Qin 饒欽 [registered in a civilian household of Qimen County 祁門縣, Huizhou Prefecture 徽州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Kegong 克恭, fourth in seniority among brothers, aged forty-five, born on the twenty-second day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Rao Chunshou 春壽, his grandfather was Rao Junliang 均亮, his father was Rao Youshan 友善, and his mother is née Yu 余氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Rao Xian 顯, Rao Jing 敬, and Rao Huang 晃, and his younger brother is Rao Zong 宗. He married a woman née Chen 陳氏. He placed one-hundredth in the Yingtian Prefectural (Provincial) Examination and fifty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His elder brother is Li Ying 英, and his younger brothers are Li Zhen 振, Li Jie 傑, and Li Fei 斐. He is married to née Zhang 張氏. 馮俊〔貫廣西慶遠府宜山縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字士彥，行一，年三十一，十一月二十三日生〕。曾祖太乙；祖思義；父永敬；母何氏。具慶下，弟傑、倫、佐，娶吳氏。廣西鄉試第六名，會試第七十三名。
translation_en:
He Guang 何廣 (registered in an official household in Hua County, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], originally from Funing County, Jiaozhi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; style name Bozhi; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the twenty-sixth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was He Feijing (District Magistrate of Anli in Jiaozhi); his grandfather was He Chun (District Magistrate of Chalang in Jiaozhi); his father is He Rulong (Assistant Magistrate of Hua County); his mother was née Mo, and his stepmother is née Chen. Both his father and stepmother are living; his elder brothers are Linli and Changshou, and his younger brothers are Lin and Zhi; he is married to née Zhou. He placed thirty-fifth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and fifty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Cheng 胡澄 (registered in a commoner household in Tangyi County, Dongchang Prefecture, Shandong; a County Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; style name Yongqing; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the twelfth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Hu Jingxian; his grandfather was Hu Yong; his father was Hu Fu; his mother is née Guo. His mother is living (his father having passed away); his younger brothers are Hao, Run, Chao, Cong, and Ji; he is married to née Liang. He placed twenty-eighth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred and first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Cong 王聰 (registered in a commoner household in Huo County, Tongzhou Subprefecture, Shuntian Prefecture; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; style name Shide; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the seventeenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Gui; his grandfather was Wang Yun; his father is Wang Jun; his mother is née Wang. Both his parents are living; his younger brother is Rui; he is married to née Guan. He placed two hundred and twenty-eighth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and eighty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Feng Jun 馮俊 (registered in a commoner household in Yishan County, Qingyuan Prefecture, Guangxi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; style name Shiyan; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-third day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Feng Taiyi; his grandfather was Feng Siyi; his father is Feng Yongjing; his mother is née He. Both his parents are living; his younger brothers are Jie, Lun, and Zuo; he is married to née Wu. He placed sixth in the Guangxi Provincial Examination and seventy-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Nan Zhao 南釗 [native place, registration, and student status illegible (25 characters); specialized in the Classic of Rites (Liji) [?]; courtesy name, seniority, age, and birth date illegible (25 characters)]. His great-grandfather was Nan Anyi 安義; his grandfather was Nan Xuan 選; his father is Nan [illegible, 2 characters] [official title illegible, 4 characters]; and his legal mother is née Ma 馬氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Nan Duo 鐸 and Nan Jin 錦. He married née Ning 寗氏. He placed 46th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 101st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Pu 張溥 [a native of Jiangdu County 江都縣, Yangzhou Prefecture 揚州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸), registered under a civilian household; National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yanbo 彥博; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the thirtieth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Er 貳; his grandfather was Zhang Ruji 汝濟; his father is Zhang Ji 輯 [Instructor (zhujiao) in the Nanjing Directorate of Education]; and his mother is née Shi 史氏. Both of his parents are living. He married née Gao 高氏. He placed 76th in the Yingtian Prefectural (Provincial) Examination and 68th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Zhen 張賑 [a native of Xiangfu County 祥符縣, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南, registered under a civilian household; Prefectural Student (fuxuesheng); specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Hongji 弘濟; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the twentieth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Yancheng 彥誠; his grandfather was Zhang Bingyi 秉彜; his father is Zhang Han 翰; and his mother is née Zhao 趙氏. Both of his parents are living. He married née Cheng 程氏. He placed 42nd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 128th in the Metropolitan Examination.

His elder brother is Wang Huan 瓛. He married née Huang 黃氏, and remarried née Yang 楊氏. He placed 161st in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 114th in the Metropolitan Examination.

戴濬〔貫福建福州府福清縣，軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字文哲，行一，年三十一，七月二十九日生〕。曾祖彥誠，祖膺〔知縣〕，父鉉，母林氏。具慶下，弟洇、浩、演，娶鄭氏，繼娶楊氏。福建鄉試第九十名，會試第四十三名。

谷琰〔貫直隸大名府開州，匠籍，國子生，治《書經》，字邦器，行一，年三十，十一月十五日生〕。曾祖友增，祖昇，父禮，母王氏，繼母靳氏。具慶下，弟琬、琇、珙，娶王氏。順天府鄉試第三十一名，會試第十九名。

徐演〔貫湖廣荊州右衛，軍籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字文敷，行三，年三十五，七月初四日生〕。曾祖子文，祖普榮，父忠，前母秦氏，母周氏，繼母漆氏。具慶下，兄弘善、溥，弟浚、福澄，娶鄢氏，繼娶吳氏。順天府鄉試第五名，會試第十名。
translation_en:
Dai Jun 戴濬 [registered in Fuqing County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian, under a military household; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Wenzhe, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-ninth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Dai Yancheng; his grandfather was Dai Ying [District Magistrate]; his father is Dai Xuan, and his mother is née Lin. Both parents are living; his younger brothers are Dai Yin, Dai Hao, and Dai Yan; he married née Zheng, and remarried née Yang. He ranked ninetieth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and forty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sheng Gai 盛侅 [registered in Wujiang County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), under a military household; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Ruyu, sixth in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the eleventh day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Sheng Sichu; his grandfather was Sheng Jinghua; his father was Sheng Qidong [Imperial Physician]; his principal mother was née Yan, and his birth mother is née Jiang. His mother is living; his elder brothers are Sheng Rubi, Sheng Rugang [Prefectural Director of Medical Studies], Sheng Ruzheng, Sheng Rude, and Sheng Rujing; his younger brothers are Sheng Tong, Sheng Zuo, and Sheng You; he married née Song, and remarried née Liu. He ranked sixty-fourth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gu Yan 谷琰 [registered in Kaizhou Subprefecture, Daming Prefecture, Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), under an artisan household; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Bangqi, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty, born on the fifteenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Gu Youzeng; his grandfather was Gu Sheng; his father is Gu Li; his mother was née Wang, and his stepmother is née Jin. His father and stepmother are both living; his younger brothers are Gu Wan, Gu Xiu, and Gu Gong; he married née Wang. He ranked thirty-first in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and nineteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Yan 徐演 [registered in Jingzhou Right Guard, Huguang, under a military household; a National University Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Wenfu, third in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the fourth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Daoheng; his grandfather was Wang Yicheng; his father was Wang Xianzhong, and his mother is née Yang. His father is deceased and his mother is living. His elder brother is Wang Yun, and his younger brother is Wang Lin. He married née Cao. He placed fourteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Feng Zun 馮遵 (registered under civilian household status in Nanhai County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Zongzhe, second in seniority, aged thirty-six, born on the thirteenth day of the second lunar month). His great-grandfather was Feng Taichu; his grandfather was Feng Guanfu; his father was Feng Yuanhu, and his mother was née Lu. Both parents are deceased. His elder brother is Feng Lian, and his younger brothers are Feng Da, Feng Xun (Tribute Student of the gengwu year [1450]), Feng Yuan (Tribute Student of the guiyou year [1453]), and Feng Yu (Tribute Student of the bingzi year [1456]). He married née Chen. He placed sixth in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Peng Zhao 彭昭 (registered in a civilian household of Xian County 獻縣, Hejian Prefecture 河間府, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸]; a County Student specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Jinghui 景輝; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the ninth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Peng Ju 彭聚, his grandfather was Peng Youxin 彭友信, his father was Peng Shijing 彭仕敬, his mother was née Yang 楊氏, and his stepmother was née Meng 孟氏. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Peng Min 彭敏, Peng Zheng 彭政, and Peng Xian 彭顯 (or Peng Minzheng 彭敏政 and Peng Xian 彭顯); his younger brothers are Peng Xuan 彭宣 and Peng Mu 彭睦. He married née Liu 劉氏, and subsequently married née Sun 孫氏. He placed fifty-ninth in the Shuntian 順天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred seventeenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qin Chong 秦崇 (registered in a military household of Shan County 單縣, Yanzhou Prefecture 兗州府, Shandong 山東; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Zhichong 智崇; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-three, born on the tenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Qin Shizhong 秦時中 (Prefect of Leizhou Prefecture 雷州府), his grandfather was Qin Yide 秦懿德 (Instructor in the Confucian School of Feixiang County 肥鄉縣), his father is Qin Yanji 秦彥吉, and his mother is née Hao 郝氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brother is Qin Sheng 秦繩. He married née Wang 王氏, and was subsequently betrothed to née Wang 王氏. He placed twenty-third in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred thirteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Yi 張頤 (registered in an official household of the Taiyuan Left Guard 太原左衛, Shanxi 山西, originally from Jiangdu County 江都縣, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸]; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Yangzheng 養正; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-third day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Yi 張義 (Battalion Commander of the Miyun Rear Guard 密雲後衛), his grandfather is Zhang Jian 張鑑 (Assistant Regional Military Commissioner of Shanxi), his father is Zhang Yu 張玉 (Vice Commander of the Taiyuan Left Guard in Shanxi), and his mother is née Wei 魏氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Zhang Tai 張泰, and his younger brothers are Zhang Qian 張謙, Zhang Jin 張晋, and Zhang Ding 張鼎. He married née Shang 尚氏. He placed fifth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and fifty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cai Lin 蔡霖 (registered in the Xingwu Guard 興武衛, originally from Yin County 鄞縣, Zhejiang 浙江; a military student of the Shuntian Prefectural School 順天府學 specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Hongji 洪濟; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Cai Wensan 蔡文三, his grandfather was Cai Heqing 蔡和卿, his father is Cai Junxiang 蔡均祥, and his mother is née Zheng 鄭氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Cai Chun 蔡春 and Cai Ning 蔡寧; his younger brothers are Cai Ding 蔡定, Cai Yun 蔡雲, and Cai Zhen 蔡震. He married née Shen 沈氏. He placed one hundred tenth in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and one hundred fifteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.
